data.value: I don't want to sleep now
Hi!
Ehh, Next time I guess...
I can't fish without a fishing rod...
There are no fish left here
I don't have the right bait for this kind of fish
I don't have enough mastery
I'm busy
I don't have enough mastery
Wake up, Keeper!
Don't make me bite you!
Ouch!
Where am I? Who are you?
You can call me Soul... and it's time for you to step forward!
It took you eight years to ruin this world... Now it's your destiny to save it.
Sounds kind of... debatable... anyway, looks like I'm all chained up here.
I'll set you free, but you have to save us all. Do you promise?
Ok, sure...
Hooray!
One chain down...
Oh, this is harder than I thought... there's simply not enough faith left in the world...
I won't be able to break the second chain...
Well then, looks like saving the world will have to wait.
This is no joke... Time is short... Summon me as soon as you can...
Hey pal... Are you back? And conscious?
Yeah, yeah...
Larry. Nice to meet you. We've been roommates for nearly a decade... he he.
A five-star Inquisitor dungeon — where torturing is maintained at an exquisite standard.
I don't remember... Do I know you?
We've never had a chance to talk. You're always in the middle of being tortured...
Or unconscious... since the Inquisitors packed up and left...
But never mind all that... Now that the fairy helped you, we might actually have a chance!
The chains won't let me move.
Well... just keep at it. You've been pulling at them for years.
The second one feels stronger though.
Those fairies, I never trust them...
Come on, don't give up that easily!
It's still so sturdy...
I have a feeling you're almost there!
Yes, I'm free!
Great job! What determination! Now get me outta this sarcophagus.
This pickaxe will do the job.
I need something to open it with.
I guess I need to equip the pickaxe first.
I... I just can't.
You're probably too weak and hungry. Do you see any food?
I think I see some mushrooms.
Very nutrient rich... and maybe even a little hallucinogenic he he...
Still won't budge.
Well did you eat the mushrooms, genius?
I hate to break it to you, but you're a...
A talking skull?! No way, that's impossible.
Right. I appreciate the sarcasm.
It's kind of my thing.
Thanks for getting me outta that can.
I got a feeling we're gonna be best buddies. Ha ha.
Let's get outta here.
Isn't a prison supposed to have guards?
Yeah, yeah — let's complain about how this isn't hard enough.
Look! A note.
So what was in the stash?
The King's signet...
... very fancy...
... an Inquisitor's medallion...
... could be useful...
.... and a rusty key.
That's what we need to open a door! Grab the lot!
Looks like I need a key.
Better bring everything from the chest.
Try to look natural. We don't want to draw any unwanted attention.
Between an escaped convict and a floating skull, you'll be the one drawing attention.
I don't know what happened, and I don't want to stick around and find out.
The best way to get lost is blend into the crowd...
Where's the Town?
We're in it... Well, inside the walls.
Just need to head down from Crown Hill...
Do you mind if I put you in my bag?
It's a bit humiliating... but you're right. A jumping skull might draw some unwanted attention... he he...
Hm... Looks like they were defending themselves from something...
Maybe... although everything looks safe enough now.
So...
So what?
So grab an axe... Clear the path.
Alright, you stupid barricade. Game on!
Good to see you dispatch such a formidable foe.
Everything is so... deserted...
Where do we even go?
We better not follow this street... the gate leads to the palace.
And you know what the palace means, right?
What?
Guards, my friend...
You're right... we want to avoid any guards...
Larry is right, we need to go the other way.
What happened here...? Where is everybody?
No idea... the place doesn't look like I remember it.
The fairy told me I ruined everything...
Don't worry... Looks like things went south while you were busy swinging in chains.
Right...
Anyway, we need to find somewhere quiet and safe to lay low.
It's quiet here... but it definitely doesn't feel safe.
Agreed... let's keep moving.
Hey there's a guy over there.
Let's get closer.
I can't get past this barricade.
Hey, mister!
Hey!
Urrrrrrrrr
What?
Urrrrrrrrr
Did you understand anything he said, Larry?
Not sure. He might have said go left then down.
Or it could have been something about your mother. He he...
How could he be so rude?!
This place looks long abandoned, Larry...
By the way, I never had a chance to ask your name.
I'm not sure... all my memories feel like bad dreams.
The fairy called me Keeper.
That's a good name... I like it.
Ok, Keeper... let's move.
Now what? The bridge is blocked.
And it's getting dark.
Lets hide in that building with the massive door.
Whoa, this is a pretty nice place.
Yeah. They even have a bed here, and some cheese.
Must be good cheese if they're even eating it in bed.
Let's start a fire. There's already a hole in the roof for the smoke.
No, no we better keep a low profile, at least until we know more.
Eat your cheese and go to bed. I'll stand guard.
You can trust your skull friend. He he.
I just hope nothing falls on me through that hole while I'm sleeping.
This is a good place — and I do need to rest.
Wake up...
Do you hear that bell?
Yeah... very grim.
Shh! Do you hear that? —
Someone's on the roof!
Sard...
Are you okay?!
Who are... Never mind — run!
Wait, what's happening?!
No time to explain!
Follow me if you want to live!
Something bad is outside.
You've got to demolish the outhouse! Hurry!
Quickly now! The sewers!
How did you even get to this part of the Town?
Well... I was just wandering around, you know...
Just like that?
A guy who sleeps in the most dangerous part of the town...
You're something else, you know. What is your name?
Umm, it's Keeper.... You can call me Keeper.
Anyway, we'll need to hurry for the last bit.
Make sure the zombies don't catch you.
The who?
Move!
Who the hell are you?
I found him in the infected part of town...
He was wandering around the Inquisitor district, completely lost.
He calls himself Keeper.
A looter. You know that's forbidden, right?
I'm not a...
Let me see what's in your bag...
Hmm... an ugly skull, a royal signet, and an Inquisitor's medallion.
Odd assortment...
I'm here... to save the...
Don't tell me you're an Inquisitor... 'cause that's a familiar tale...
Sir! A new wave of zombies is approaching!
You're not a zombie... maybe you actually are an Inquisitor...
Either way, you can hold a weapon.
That's all that matters right now.
You haven't got armor and a sword, though...
Go get them from the workshop.
Hello. I need armor and a sword.
Sure. I just dish it out to whoever comes in here.
Uhh...
Lucky for you I invented these conveyor belts.
I can get resources to the workbench in no time!
Now, with the semi-automatic workbench, your armor will be ready in a snap.
Impressive, right?
Absolutely. I finally had enough time to get over my midlife crisis.
Never mind me, just take the armor and go.
Since you're carrying armor and a sword, you might as well equip them.
You look great in the armor. Just like a real Inquisitor.
Speaking of which — our boys could use some motivation.
Look, guys, we've got a real Inquisitor here with us!
Wow.
That's awesome!
Take this party and go defend the right flank.
Okay, ready guys? Let's go.
Look at you, climbing the ranks!
What are you waiting for? Grab the banner and lead the guys to battle.
Fall back to the port everyone!
I've heard of your plight.
And I've come to vanquish all thy foes!
It took me three days and three nights to get here, aboard a merchant ship.
But now I'm ready to be your savior!
Die you filthy abominations!
Hey! Wait! Biting isn't fair!
Help! Urrrr....
That was anticlimactic.
At least he bought us some time. Let's go for the gates.
Dammit! Those village idiots blocked the gates again.
Hey, villagers. Open up!
No can do. The village chief says no-no.
Since when does he have more authority than me?! Open up!
Maybe we should open it?
Why?
I think those guys need our help.
Naah. They're fine.
Looks like we're all gonna be eaten. Even my bones are about to get gnawed over.
Maybe show them your fancy medallion?
What's an Inquisitor doing with you lot?
You're here to save us, right?
You know, to help us and restore the Inquisition in the Citadel.
For I have the King's signet!
I bear the King's signet, after all...
Wow, he has so much shiny stuff. Must be an Inquisitor.
Move, move!
Close the gate!
Wow... We nearly died.
Argh... You know what? You can stay here!
But you're definitely not allowed to enter the village without permission.
As you wish... I'll have a few words with your boss tomorrow!
Oh nooo... all my favorite equipment is in there!
I've been setting it up for ages!
I wish there was something we could do about it, my friend...
We need to save it... Fight them back!
Sure, you bet... but for now, I need you to check all our supplies.
We need rest.
Meet you all at the guard tower...
As for you...
I know you're not an Inquisitor...
Whaaaaaaaaat? That's slander!!
... but I honestly don't care.
Even an impostor may be of use right now.
We need to bury the fallen on this side of the gate
Since you call yourself a Keeper... You do it.
Fine... I'll figure something out.
There's an abandoned Inquisitor base to the west.
So... as an Inquisitor, I have rights to the place, right?
Whatever... Sure, I guess you do...
Find a place for a graveyard there.
I'll arrange the body delivery in the morning.
When you're done, return to me with the burial certificates.
The Inquisitor's base sounds like a great place to crash.
Why?
Well, we're basically homeless — and it's a whole fricking base!
You're right... I think it might be a good place to stay...
Hold it right there. No one passes through.
Not until the Head of the Village says otherwise.
Look... the ruins of an ancient god's temple...
Can't think of a better place for a graveyard...
It's the closest thing to a holy place we're gonna find...
There's even a spot for a cozy little morgue..
Sounds like an easy job to me.
Let's move... and check out our new property.
Who knows... maybe it comes with a complimentary skeleton for you.
Ha ha... hilarious! You're on fire...
That hut looks promising.
You should go to bed.
I heard you living types kinda need sleep.
And put me on the box by the bed. I don't like being stuck in a dark sack.
Heh... So dusty... But it's better than the Inquisitor dungeon...
Much better. I actually like this place.
We found a place to lay low... he he.
We just need to clean it up and fix a few things.
Yeah... it's so dusty I'm gonna sneeze.
You literally have nothing to sneeze with.
Fair point... see you tomorrow.
I believe that's our cue.
I'll wait for you by the morgue.
I'm a respectable, distinguished, magical animal!
And what do they ask of me? Carry dead bodies.
This world has no sense of justice.
You do have quite an advanced vocabulary for a donkey...
I think I'm having a deja vu.
What were you saying about justice?
Never mind that, I'm actually happy doing any work at all.
It's way better than becoming lunch meat.
Speaking of which, I brought you a dead body. It needs to be buried.
Okay, grab the body and follow me.
So this is the morgue.
How do you know?
While you were sleeping, I stretched my bones a bit.
Now put the body on the autopsy table.
How did you manage to lose the body already? Go get it!
So what now?
No idea.
Since everybody is starving...
... maybe we should cut a piece off and sell it?
Are you crazy? How do you even come up with this stuff?
A much better plan would be taking everything from his pockets!
I mean, he looks fine.
I'm sure at some point we'll figure out the whole autopsy thing.
Oh look — there's actually a book on precisely that!
Okay, take the body and follow me.
Hey, where's the body? Get it back!
You can bury him here...
It's not right to just throw him into a hole.
He needs some kind of gravestone... or at least a sign.
You're free to use whatever you find in that chest.
Just don't forget the shovel...
Now put the sign on the grave...
It's not much, but whatever...
Good job. Now we can go and show this certificate to the Head of the Guards.
Thanks for burying the dead...
I had a friendly chat with the Head of the Village.
He also owns the village tavern. You can find him there.
He goes in for fairy tales and mumbo jumbo, but he'll pay good money for every burial from now on.
You said fairy? Do you think he'd know how to summon one?
Heh... summon what?
A fairy told me to summon her... so I can save the world...
Heh... yeah, that sounds like his sort of thing.
I'd say you two weirdos kind of speak the same language.
That's good news.
Glad to hear it... especially considering how bad things are right now.
There's too few people left... just a handful of guards, and a company of mercenary swordsmen.
Morale's really low...
After all, you're talking to an Inquisitor... and the Graveyard Keeper...
Maybe a better-looking graveyard would boost the morale of the poor souls around here.
You're actually serious, aren't you? Since, like... we're all gonna end up there soon...
What the sard... the lads might actually appreciate the irony!
Sure, spruce up the graveyard... and I'll owe you a favor.
Deal!
We don't have much to offer.
We need everything — literally everything.
I understand... we're really sorry.
Doesn't he... don't you understand how important this is?!
We just need more resources and manpower!
There's nothing we can do... we don't even have enough food here.
Nonsense!
Ah, the man of the hour! I'm glad someone finally took up the burial business...
I'll be buying those burial certificates from you.
It's kind of an old tradition... Though funny enough, we've never had a graveyard before.
Great.
I heard you know a lot about fairies?
I've got a fairy-related question for you.
Oh, then you need Jully... wait a sec...
Who's asking for me?
Weren't we... just talking?
Not that I recall. State your business!
I need to summon a fairy.
Do you know what I should do?
Of course I know... In matters of nature, my knowledge is complete!
So... would you be so kind as to tell me?
Certainly not.
Who are you, anyway? Another schmuck from the hill?
I'm the Graveyard Keeper... and part-time Inquisitor!
Not impressed. You townsfolk always need something...
You should try giving more.
Help the village, and maybe... just maybe... one day I'll share my secrets.
Just tell me how I can help.
How? Nearly everything is bad!
Could you be a little more specific?
You know what? I don't have time for this... go ask Januarius.
So... how did your conversation with the Head of the Village go?
It didn't go great.
Oh... sorry to hear that.
Right.... Listen... Can you tell me how I can help the village?
Hmm... It seems our main problem is the lack of food. And firewood.
I actually have some spare land at my place.
I could plant something there.
That's jolly good!
You should talk to the Merchant about the food supplies...
He might have some seeds for you as well.
Ok, I will.
What kind of merchant are you?!
No materials, no tools. How can we fight to get my workshop back?!
I guess you could try finding stuff at the port.
The twins have a boat. You could get there that way.
Okay. I'll go talk to them.
Greetings! Never seen you before.
I'm the new Graveyard Keeper. From the hill.
Very interesting. Always good to see a new face. Good for business!
Speaking of business — I heard you're having problems with the food supply?
Oh ho ho! We're short on everything. Not much land to grow food.
No woodcutting either — thanks to Jully's spiritual beliefs.
Well, I do have plenty of land to farm and trees to cut on the hill.
That's just marvelous! I'd gladly accept some samples.
Wait... like, for free?
Of course! Good will is the essence of business.
Ok, then I just need some seeds.
I'd be glad to sell you some.
Wait... that sounds a little unfair.
I'm not proud of it, but I've got to make ends meet somehow.
Is there any other way I could help you with provisions?
It would be nice if I sold you a fishing rod.
Then I could buy fish from you.
You need free samples of the fish?
That's a great idea! Except the twins took my fishing rod.
Come to think of it, they were supposed to give it back a whole week ago.
Could you go check on them?
They live on the other side of the river.
Are you sleeping?
Don't go to sleep!
Holy... Jack! It's night and you're in my house!
So I have this plan — it's genius.
There was a stronghold at the port. Some people might have remained there.
I hoped the brothers would help me get there, but their boat sank.
Wasn't this the Merchant's plan? I heard you discussing it.
Umm... who cares who came up with it, alright?
I need a boat, and you owe me.
What? What do I owe you for?
I gave you some great armor! What, you thought it was free?
Don't worry, I'll build the boat myself.
That's a piece of cake for a professional like me.
I just need the materials.
Will you help me...
Sure, sure... just let me get some sleep first!
Great, here's a list!
I'll wait for you in the village... on the beach across the bridge.
Wow... better him a friend than an enemy.
Anyway... we seriously need a lock on that door.
Uhhh...
I don't get what he wants...
I. Need. Your. Boat!
Sorry, the boat sank.
You've got to be kidding me.
It's [your] fault!
I told you to row!
I was busy steering!
I thought [I] was steering!
That's right. You thought you were steering, and that's why this is your fault!
You know what?
What?
We're not brothers anymore, Heffry!
While you're figuring out your... relationship issues...
Could you give me your fishing rod?
What rod?
Uhh... maybe Jeffry knows where it is. He's the smart one.
Where did he go?
Down the road... then turn... uhh...
Right? Left?
Uhh... not to the bridge... behind the tree...
Very specific. Thanks.
Tell him I want to be his brother again.
Hi... your brother told me you know where the fishing rod is.
Oh yeah... the rod... it's somewhere... I can't remember... too much stress...
How is he?
How is...
How's Heffry getting by without me?
But — you only just left. Whatever...
He misses you. He wants you to be his brother again.
We're both just too nervous. It's all on account of the pottery...
Pottery?
We sank the boat with some pottery... meant for Herm...
Ok, I can make pottery for you. And you can go find that fishing rod.
I'll go to him. We'll be waiting for the pottery.
This pottery looks ugly.
Pottery is pottery.
Take this fishing rod. As a thank you.
These samples are phenomenal.
This is the best harvest we've had in some time.
So, will you buy my vegetables from now on?
Quality products demand quality compensation.
You know, being back in business feels good.
We might even rack up a surplus and start trading.
I have some spare seeds too.
If you keep trading with me, that will definitely increase your reputation in the village.
And we'll be able to expand my business.
That's great news.
"You don't have to shout good news. It need only be whispered."
I can't help but ask, what's with the quotes?
Oh, never mind. It's just from a book I like.
So what's your plan? Are we going to gather some supplies and fight the zombies back?
What? No, of course not!
All we've been doing is retreating... and losing faith.
Seems there's nowhere left to retreat... and no faith left to lose.
And everybody's just... kinda okay with it.
That's sad to hear.
But very true to say.
So with a little faith on your side, you'll fight the zombies back?
Maybe... We can try it at least.
But I can't imagine where you're going to find enough faith...
Here's everything you asked for.
There are some... complications with building the boat.
But don't worry, I'm a professional!
I just need a set bronze tools.
You can't really get them in the village.
Is that all you need? Just so I don't run back and forth.
Don't worry, that's the last thing I need.
... Oh wait... I also need those two boys in matching outfits there to row.
Of course you do.
They told me they'd agree... if someone they trust asked them.
Ok, I'll talk to them.
Are you guys ready to row to the port?
Hooray, we're about to have a boat again!
Yeah, I wouldn't be so thrilled. The Shop Foreman's gifts are never free...
Thanks! Once I get my workshop back, I'll take you on as an apprentice.
Now, ask the brothers if they're ready for the trip to the port.
Okay, I'll ask them.
Yep, everything is ready. We're just waiting for right wind!
I'll send you a message on our return.
How can I summon one?
Hmm... You have helped us, I'll give you that.
Maybe you really are starting to think beyond more than just yourself...
Fairies... hmm...
Ancient spirits of nature... from a time before the god with the red eye.
Hey, I saw that guy! He even talked to me!
Yeah, yeah... don't talk rubbish. He's long gone! Abandoned us all...
There's a village on the other side of town. They still worship him — can you believe it?
Anyway... back to fairies.
You'll need a couple of teeth.
Will a dead man's teeth work?
Yeah... hmm... in that case, you'd also need Dream Dust.
Where am I supposed to find that?
Where indeed... You won't like this...
The Plague Doctor... that excuse of a man.
He's your one option... But I have to warn you... He's cursed.
Well I'll try to—
His cursed home is somewhere... underground.
Yeah... I've seen him in the dungeon under my house...
Interesting... it's the first time in many years that someone actually cares.
So... we going to fight the zombies back now?
Oh no, not we... mostly you. I'm too old for this.
Ok, I'm ready! Let's kick some zombie butt!
Not so fast...
We need to prepare. And since our dear Master Jack has abandoned ship,
it's up to you to gather all the supplies and materials we'll need.
Hmm... Sounds like a lot of work.
Yes, it is.
We need to bring our Sword count to an appropriate number.
And I can assure you... that isn't happening without that squad of Hired Swords on board.
Ok... I think I can manage all this...
Hold on...
Even with all that, we'll still need a miracle...
to beat all those zombies. Or a cheap trick.
A cheap trick?
Like an ace up your sleeve.
Alright... Tell me.
We need to make a bell...
A mesmerizing half-hour later...
Heh... I'm just glad you're the one testing it.
Bring me the bell. I'll get everything else prepared.
Good to hear. I hope you'll lead our forces into battle!
Here's the bell I was talking about.
I'll set it up and explain to everyone just how important it is...
Everything seems ready...
Just take this red banner. The others will follow you.
Well well... I wish I could say you did  good job...
Then just say it.
There was no hope for us before.
There was nothing left to defend... at least, that's how it felt.
But now... I have this strange feeling... Hope.
That actually sounds kind of... good?
Heh... I was supposed to retire the week all this started.
But now? There's no peace, no quiet, and definitely no time for reading a good book.
Anyway... it's your call now. Use what we took by sword, and secure this area.
I'll check the perimeter and assign more guards.
Good job!
Something went wrong. We couldn't take them. This time.
Can't say I'm surprised... But you're free to keep trying.
Usually, we only assemble our defense lines once a week. After the bell rings.
But this area near the gate is always secure.
You can try again when you're ready.
Come in.
Hi...
We're back from port. And we got a Nun.
A nun? Where's Jack?
He stayed at the port...
But sent you a message...
The Nun at the tavern... she's waiting for you.
Thanks.
My dear friend,
To begin with, I have to tell you — the material you provided...
Hey... keep it down.
... was very low quality indeed!
This is the sole reason for the poor seaworthiness of the boat I built.
Therefore, I'm not risking my way back by sea...
My place on the boat will be taken by the Nun.
She promised to help boost your morale.
Anything else, sweetie?
Yeah... one more... for my friend.
And one from my friend...
How thoughtful of you.
Be back in a minute...
Where was I... Ah yes, I met an absolutely brilliant man of science.
He recognized my extraordinary skills!
And oddly enough, he seemed to know quite a bit about someone...
Who resembles you quite closely... Very strange...
He also shared a recipe with me, for a bell.
Instructions enclosed on how to build and use the bell.
It should help you fight off the zombies and clear out the port district.
P.S. There's no materials here. The warehouse is in the zombie part of the port.
We'll get to it as soon as you retake the port.
P.S.S. Please avoid using the boat until we've recovered the warehouse....
Did you get any of that?
Yeah, easy. First meet the Nun at the village tavern.
Second, get to the port district through the town full of zombies.
What about the bell?
That's not clear for now, but keep that recipe ready.
When life gives you a recipe for a magic bell, you'll probably need one soon enough.
Ah at last...
I'm here to talk to the Nun.
Could you please hurry up and do whatever she asks?
The sooner we get her out of the tavern, the better.
I mean... she's scaring away all my customers!
I'll see what I can do...
Hi, I'm the local Graveyard Keeper. I heard you were looking for me.
I heard you're also an Inquisitor. Is that true?
Yes... Yes I am. I have a medallion and everything.
Excellent! At last, someone who can burn all those heretics!
Sweeeet....
Have you finished repairing the old temple for me?
Uh... I'm still kind of in the middle of the process...
Don't lie to me! You know nothing of temples!
Here... take this book: "So You Decided to Decorate Your Church."
It's a classic.
Thanks... I guess.
Now go! Decorate the church so I can perform a ceremony!
Once everything's ready, I'll perform the first ceremony myself.
And why exactly should I help you and sort out the church?
Don't talk rubbish! Faith!
Faith?
You'll definitely need plenty.
Trust me... I'm a nun!
Holy signs shall visit upon you...
... Okay.
Pleeeeeaseeee...
You say something?
Who? Me?
Nooooo...
Wow, our very own dungeon! How cool is that?!
You know... I have some bad memories about dungeons.
No, no... listen...
I think it's actually a pretty big one. Maybe even connects different places underground.
It might even be linked to the town sewers.
Can you imagine how many interesting things might be hidden in the dungeon of a mysterious Inquisitor's base?
Hmm... maybe you're right. This basement could be useful.
We need to explore it.
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
I'll never find a way inside the tower...
Hey! Who are you?
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
*cough-cough*
I thought you peasants were afraid of dungeons.
Hey, I'm not a peasant. I'm the Graveyard Keeper...
... and part-time Inquisitor!
And actually this is my dungeon!
Whatever... Good for you...
I fear I shall never escape this heavy burden.
Who the sard was that?!
Don't know for sure...
But my guess — the Plague Doctor.
And I've got business with him.
You know what?
What?
I kinda like it down here!
Guess I got used to dark, underground places...
Yeah, you kinda blend in.
Also, my nose is itching... just like the first time they brought you to the dungeon!
We definitely need to get rid of this blockage and explore deeper.
And by we, I mostly mean you!
So I'll wait upstairs while you... deal with that mess.
Make ready as you will!
